{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count completed orders, excluding QA orders
completed_orders = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (~data.index.isin(qa_orders.index))]
completed_count = len(completed_orders)

# Print the result
print(completed_count)"}
